description: This file contains unit tests for tenant client utilities, including functions for normalizing tenant IDs, fetching session tenants, selecting tenants, and managing active tenant records in local storage.

methods.name: normalizeTenantId
methods.description: Normalizes various tenant ID formats into a string identifier, or null if input is invalid.

methods.name: fetchSessionTenants
methods.description: Fetches tenants associated with the current session from the server.

methods.name: selectTenant
methods.description: Selects a tenant, updates local storage, and communicates the selection to the server.

methods.name: setActiveTenant
methods.description: Sets the active tenant in local storage, removing legacy entries.
